subject: arcticOutpost
pitch:
Category: Diorama.
Subject: arctic research outpost.
Style: Firewatch flat colour.

requests.what: Neon emergency light bar across the cabin roof: a slim dark housing, six alternating CYAN and MAGENTA lamps, and two metal mounting brackets. Keep it graphic and highly visible.
Arctic communications antenna array: three thin antenna rods with small crossbars and a compact orange signal box, in DARK_METAL, METAL and WARNING.
Two tilted rectangular solar panels on low brackets, deep blue-black cells divided by pale METAL lines. Place them on the rear roof plane without hiding the light bar.
Raised station sign reading POLAR WATCH in chunky cream letters on a dark plaque, with a tiny orange compass emblem. Mount centered above the front door.
Door hardware: a bright WARNING push bar, three dark hinges, a small cyan access panel and a red emergency pull tab.
Frost patterns around the front window: chunky branching ice decals in SNOW and ICE, leaving the glowing amber interior visible in the centre.
Generator ventilation grille on the annex side: five horizontal DARK_METAL slats, a red warning triangle and two yellow bolts.
A rack of three squat red fuel canisters beside the generator annex, with black caps, pale labels and a retaining metal strap.
Black insulated power cables running from the generator toward the cabin wall, with three yellow fastening clips. Use a clean, readable draped route.
Four tall orange-and-black snow stakes around the station perimeter, each with a tiny reflective yellow flag.
Flat Firewatch-style geometric weathering on the left hull: large HULL and HULL_DARK angular blocks, subtle SNOW grime along the lower edge, and a faded white unit number near the rear.
A mirrored but slightly different blocky HULL/HULL_DARK paint pattern on the right hull, with broad clean shapes rather than noisy realism.
Broad graphic snow caps on the roof ridges and eaves in SNOW and SNOW_SHADOW, leaving the orange roof colour visible as a bold border.
Simple pale-blue diagonal ice reflections across the front window, plus a warm amber lower glow. Keep the window readable as glass.
